title: AI代理实际需要多少内存？
summary: 本文探讨了AI代理（Agent）在执行任务时所需的内存大小问题，提出了一种名为ALTK-Evolve的框架，用于动态评估和优化代理的内存配置。文章指出，传统上代理的内存大小是固定的，但实际需求会随任务复杂度、上下文长度和工具调用频率而变化。通过实验，作者发现过大的内存会导致资源浪费和推理延迟增加，而过小的内存则会导致信息丢失和性能下降。ALTK-Evolve通过进化算法自动调整内存分配策略，在保持任务准确率的同时，显著降低了内存占用和推理成本。实验结果表明，该框架在多个基准测试中平均减少约30%的内存使用，同时保持或提升任务完成质量。文章还讨论了内存与代理长期记忆、短期记忆的关系，并提出了未来研究方向，包括多模态记忆和自适应遗忘机制。
summary_en: This article explores how much memory AI agents actually need and proposes a framework called ALTK-Evolve to dynamically assess and optimize memory allocation for agents. It argues that fixed memory sizes are suboptimal, as requirements vary with task complexity, context length, and tool usage. Through experiments, the authors show that excessive memory wastes resources and increases latency, while insufficient memory causes information loss and performance degradation. ALTK-Evolve uses an evolutionary algorithm to automatically adjust memory allocation, reducing memory usage by about 30% on average across benchmarks while maintaining or improving task accuracy. The paper also discusses the relationship between long-term and short-term memory in agents and suggests future directions such as multimodal memory and adaptive forgetting.
